caseName: Lee M. Scarborough & Co. v. Fox
caseNameFull: Lee M. Scarborough & Co. v. Fox, Special Deputy Commissioner of Insurance of Wisconsin for the Liquidation of All-Star Insurance Corp. and APS Insurance Agency, Inc. v. Fox, Special Deputy Commissioner of Insurance of Wisconsin for the Liquidation of All-Star Insurance Corp.

opinions.text:
Appeals from Sup. Ct. Wis. dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Justice White and Justice Powell would note probable jurisdiction and set cases for oral argument.

Reported below: 110 Wis. 2d 72, 327 N. W. 2d 648.
